species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 37°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–32 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 37°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 2–18 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
South wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 37°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
